prompt: Amara is seven and she needs her hair done for the school photograph on Thursday. I have been watching videos for two weeks. My mother offered to come and I said I can manage. There is no one in my family who has done this before, a man alone with a daughter, and the people who give advice are always giving advice for a situation they understand better than mine.
